en.title: A steel crown for a baby back tooth

sentences.text: This is a baby back tooth in a child's lower jaw. Under it, the adult tooth is growing.
Here, decay has made holes on more than one side of the tooth.
A large filling leaves only thin walls of tooth around it.
For a steel crown, the dentist most often numbs the tooth, takes out the decay and trims it a little.
Then the dentist glues a ready-made metal cap over the whole tooth.
After 2 years, about 93 in 100 crowns were still working well, compared with 80 in 100 large fillings.
